استعفوا (form X)
# اِسْتَعْفَوْا (istaʕfaw) /is.taʕ.faw/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَعْفَى (istaʕfā)
# اُسْتُعْفُوا (ustuʕfū) /us.tuʕ.fuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَعْفَى (istaʕfā)
# اِسْتَعْفُوا (istaʕfū) /is.taʕ.fuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَعْفَى (istaʕfā)
